entries.mechanism: NTT attestations are evaluated against the CURRENT threshold and CURRENT enabled-transceiver set at execution time, rather than against the (threshold, enabled-set) snapshot that existed when the attestation was recorded. Administrative threshold/transceiver reductions and re-enables are deliberate admin actions.
entries.impact: an attestation recorded under one transceiver/threshold config counting toward quorum under a later config (incl. re-enable of a previously-removed transceiver) — DECLARED NON-ISSUE.
entries.raw_text: NTT attestations are evaluated against live threshold/transceiver config rather than a snapshot taken when the attestation was recorded; admin threshold reductions are deliberate; any fraudulent-attestation scenario requires a quorum of malicious Guardians (out of scope).

entries.class: exchange-rate inflation / precision loss within bound

enzyme-onyx.net_new_guidance: Only ChainSecurity touched this code. Highest net-new probability in QA-ONLY components (SyncDepositHandler cached-price arbitrage beyond staleness bound, CRE consumer re-entrancy [QA confidence LOW, system risk MEDIUM, NOT validated], DepositQueue external-list enum-extension), and in any logic NOT exercised by the fee/share-conservation invariants the main audit centered on. Core inflation/donation/low-share attacks are ACCEPTED-RISK (CS-ONYX-011) => FORECLOSE any finding in that class. Admin-trust assumptions (Notes 8.1, 11 items) are by-design => FORECLOSE admin-misoperation findings.

entries.mechanism: FeeHandler.claimFees() did not validate _value <= owed; int256->uint256 downcast underflows on over-claim. Fix: split __updateValueOwed into __increaseValueOwed/__decreaseValueOwed, uint256-only, no int casts.
entries.impact: CRITICAL — theft of all feeAssetsSrc funds + permanent DoS of updateShareValue (netValue underflow).

entries.mechanism: Redemption computed exit feeSharesAmount but burned only netShares; fee shares remained in queue balance while still counted in totalSupply. Fix: burn gross request.sharesAmount.
entries.impact: HIGH — permanently inflates totalSupply, deflates share price for all holders on every non-zero exit-fee redemption.

entries.mechanism: HWM set to pre-performance-fee valuePerShare while actual share value is post-fee, so HWM always > end-of-period share value. Fix: subtract perf fee from _netValue -> netValueIncludingFee, set HWM to that.
entries.impact: MEDIUM — fund must re-earn last perf fee before charging new perf fees (under-charges manager; not a user-loss).

entries.mechanism: ValueHelpersLib.convert() imprecise when quote asset has low decimals + conversion done per-1-share then scaled. GUSD(8dec) example loses ~90 units per 10k shares. Fix: convert without intermediate scale-down of share price.
entries.impact: LOW — rounding loss to redeemer/depositor on low-decimal assets.

entries.class: valuation race condition (fee claim vs price update)
entries.mechanism: getTotalValueOwed reduced by a concurrent fee-claim tx ordered before admin updateShareValue while submitted positions value still includes those fees -> inflated fund value. Fix: only admins may claim fees (claim+update both admin-gated).
entries.impact: LOW — transient inflated valuation if recipient claim front-runs admin update.
entries.status: fixed (CodeCorrected V1) — fee-claim restricted to admins in V2

entries.mechanism: removePositionTracker reverts on missing tracker but unsetAssetOracle silently deletes. Fix: unsetAssetOracle removed in favor of manually-set rates.
entries.impact: INFO — developer confusion / off-chain state bugs.

entries.mechanism: @custom:storage-location tag had extra '.storage' segment vs code-computed slot (enzyme.storage.X vs enzyme.X). Fix: removed extra segment.
entries.impact: INFO — tooling may mislocate storage; no runtime effect.

entries.mechanism: AccountERC20Tracker values position via asset.balanceOf(_account); attacker front-runs valuation with a donation to inflate valuePerShare, then redeems to steal part of a victim deposit. Requires admin to execute a single very-low-value deposit.
entries.impact: LOW-sev rated; partial theft of a victim deposit on a fresh fund. ACCEPTED — Onyx intentionally does NOT protect against inflation/donation/low-supply attacks in core; admins told to mint existential shares.

entries.class: fee change applied to pending requests
entries.mechanism: Entry/exit fees mutable by admin at any time; requests do not persist fee at creation and fees are taken at execution. Admin can raise fee then execute a pre-existing request.
entries.impact: LOW-sev; user pays higher-than-expected fee. ACCEPTED — admins trusted; their process governs whether to process pre-fee-change requests.

entries.mechanism: ...HighWaterMarkTimestampIsZero thrown when hwmTimestamp==0 AND hurdleRate!=0; name only describes timestamp condition.
entries.impact: INFO. ACCEPTED.

entries.mechanism: setHurdleRate enforces non-negative int16 but no upper-bound check; bounded only by int16 max 327.67%.
entries.impact: INFO. ACCEPTED.

entries.mechanism: executeDepositRequests reverts whole batch if any request yields 0 shares (1 wei asset & share value >1e18); symmetric in RedeemQueue when share price <1e18 (require(netShares>0)).
entries.impact: INFO/minor DoS. ACKNOWLEDGED — filtering dust requests is intended admin process, so 'no DoS'.

entries.mechanism: No event params indexed (except IERC7540Like deposit/redeem handler events).
entries.impact: INFO. ACKNOWLEDGED — Enzyme does not rely on indexed events off-chain.

entries.mechanism: 11-point trusted-admin assumption list: valuation must use correct values; deposit/redeem exec must be atomic right after updateShareValue (else front-run); asset change needs oracle/rate set first; resetLastSettled only pre-start; resetHighWaterMark must not disadvantage; no positive-value valuation on zero-share fund; minRequestDuration>0; bound LinearCreditDebtTracker item count (OOG DoS); no misappropriation; no very-low-value request exec (revert + inflation vector); admins claim fees for recipients (V2).
entries.impact: By-design. Any issue arising from admin mis-operation within these assumptions is OUT-OF-SCOPE / known.

entries.mechanism: HWM stored fund-level not per-user; after a drawdown new depositors pay no perf fee until prior peak regained though they gain along the way.
entries.impact: By-design known. Late joiners advantaged.

entries.mechanism: Mgmt fee = pct of (value - already-accrued fees); settled each valuation update -> total annual fee decreases as update frequency increases (10% annual -> ~95.54 if monthly).
entries.impact: By-design known. Fee under-charge with frequent updates.

entries.class: third-party donation to fee source -> inflated valuation
entries.mechanism: Third party sends funds to feeAssetsSrc; total fees owed reduced (claimable) without fund's knowledge -> inflated valuation next update if admin submits positions value still including claimed fees and address/FeeHandler unmonitored.
entries.impact: By-design known; depends on admin monitoring.

entries.mechanism: DepositorWallet constructor did not call _disableInitializers(); anyone could init() the implementation and become walletsManager, then executeCalls/sendCCIPMessage to drain assets sent to the impl address. Fix: constructor now calls _disableInitializers().
entries.impact: INFO (impl-only assets). FIXED.

entries.mechanism: DeterministicBeaconFactory.deployProxy has no access control; salt namespaced by msg.sender so no address collision with WalletsManager wallets, BUT attacker proxies still recorded in isInstance, mixing real wallets with arbitrary third-party proxies; any isInstance consumer could trust attacker proxies.
entries.impact: INFO. ACCEPTED — keeps pattern consistent with other factories.

entries.mechanism: CallExecuted/CCIPMessageSent/ChainSelectorSet/UserSet/WalletsManagerSet/CCIPMessageProcessed/MessageDataProcessingFailed emit no indexed params.
entries.impact: INFO. ACCEPTED.

entries.mechanism: If a return token's residual after exact fee deduction is 0, Router.ccipSend transfers 0 tokens to pool -> may revert on some token implementations.
entries.impact: INFO. ACCEPTED — deemed highly unlikely fee exactly matches sent amount.

entries.mechanism: _ccipReceive forwards safeTransfer(wallet, message-declared amount) not actual received balance; sendCCIPMessage approves message amount read from balanceOf -> FoT/rebasing break accounting. Unsupported by design.
entries.impact: System Consideration — FoT/rebasing tokens OUT OF SCOPE / unsupported.

entries.mechanism: DeterministicBeaconFactory.setImplementation takes effect immediately for every DepositorWallet; owner can swap impl with no user-exit window; no on-chain mitigation. (Global.owner fully trusted, worst case: malicious impl drains all wallets.)
entries.impact: System Consideration — admin/owner-trust accepted; DC-9 sub-3 analogue but trusted-owner = known/accepted.

entries.mechanism: AddressListBase stores mapping(address=>bool); no on-chain member enumeration, consumers must index ItemAdded/ItemRemoved off-chain. QA: access-control + list logic both straightforward, low system risk.
entries.impact: NOTE/INFO — by design.

entries.mechanism: (a) __validateSetList require mixes &&/|| without parens (precedence correct). (b) transfer initiator/operator (msg.sender on transferFrom) is NEVER validated — only _from/_to; spender cannot be list-gated. (c) Shares.authTransfer/authTransferFrom BYPASS the validator (admin/system transfers not allow/block-listed) — by design.
entries.impact: NOTE — allowlist/blocklist gates only user-facing transfer/transferFrom principals, not the operator nor admin/system transfers.

entries.mechanism: DepositQueue external IAddressList gate: (a) setDepositRestriction(External) before setting controllerAllowlist reverts all deposits until configured (no cross-validation). (b) __validateDepositRequest has no final else{revert} — if enum extended, new value silently passes. (c) switching away from External does not clear stored controllerAllowlist (stale, harmless).
entries.impact: NOTE/INFO — fail-closed; admin-correctable; enum-extension foot-gun.

entries.class: CRE consumer re-entrancy / forwarder-whitelist trust (medium-systemrisk note)
entries.mechanism: CreWorkflowConsumer.onReport forwards reports to LimitedAccessLimitedCallForwarder. QA flags: (a) re-entrancy into onReport if a system action triggers KeystoneForwarder report delivery mid-execution (QA confidence LOW — not validated, system risk MEDIUM). (b) compromised DON/KeystoneForwarder bounded only by forwarder (target,selector) whitelist; canCall validates selector only, NOT call params. (c) init() has no access control (double-init blocked) + does not verify consumer registered as forwarder user (deploy sequencing).
entries.impact: MEDIUM system risk per QA but Chainlink infra TRUSTED per trust model + forwarder whitelist OUT OF SCOPE; bounded by admin whitelist. NOTE/known. NOTE: CreWorkflowConsumer was NOT in the main Dec-2025 audit scope.
entries.status: by-design / trusted-infra (QA note, MEDIUM systemrisk flagged) — partial coverage

entries.mechanism: After init, default depositorAllowlist=address(0) and maxSharePriceStaleness=0 (blocks deposits, needs same-block price). If admin sets staleness BEFORE configuring allowlist, anyone can deposit in that window (init only takes asset; allowlist+staleness set in separate txs).
entries.impact: INFO — transient permissionless-deposit window from config ordering.

entries.mechanism: SyncDepositHandler mints pro-rata shares in one tx using a CACHED ValuationHandler share price (not recomputed), gated by maxSharePriceStaleness + per-asset rate expiry. QA: stale price -> more/fewer shares than warranted; arbitrage window = staleness bound. System risk LOW only IF maxSharePriceStaleness is tight and price updates frequent.
entries.impact: Bounded by maxSharePriceStaleness config. QA-acknowledged as the core risk; NOT a filed finding. Mint-before-transfer ordering deviates from CEI but atomic.
entries.component: SyncDepositHandler.__deposit (cached share price from ValuationHandler) + convertAssetAmountToValue
